notes.title: Dangerous Fellows is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44110096/cbfb39fdb81a12fbb1dd5014089c325d3611a457.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44110096/7e9772f89f75f18334a4ce76bbe646f5e9da4994.png[/img][/url]

Storytaco, an interactive story game developer, is pleased to announce the release of "Dangerous Fellows," a female-oriented visual novel game, on the Steam platform.

“Dangerous Fellows” borrows a dystopian, apocalyptic setting with a zombie theme, a rarity among female-oriented story games. It was released as a mobile game and has been steadily gaining popularity among users with over 7 million global downloads.

The Steam version of "Dangerous Fellows" will be released in June 2023.

"We are very excited to release 'Dangerous Fellows' on Steam, and we hope that many people will enjoy the game," said Jeil Kim, CEO of Storytaco.
